scope: Numerical proposal construction from the actual released anchored surrogate density; no posterior, evidence, fitted-cosmology or unseen-mode qualification.

surrogate.role: Existing independently validated broad quartic, chosen before this anchored preflight/optimization. This changes only the numerical proposal, whose own native correction remains required.

target: Use unchanged anchored_sampling.configuration/settings/identify. The proposal density is accuracy-one surrogate plus native fallback and the full 1657-row anchored SN likelihood. Final native accuracy is separately identified; every normalized prior and physical-domain restriction remains unchanged. No bridge weights enter this fit.
reference_role: The frozen original Gaussian/t5 covariance defines affine coordinates only. It supplies neither an observation nor a posterior constraint.
starts: Three deterministic starts: reference mean and plus/minus two marginal H0 standard deviations along the reference conditional mean direction C[:,H0]/C[H0,H0]. All starts remain recorded even if invalid.
search_box_role: Finite numerical search region only, not a scientific prior or support boundary. The frozen Gaussian/t5 proposal has full real support; every proposed point is evaluated against the unchanged target.
failed_native_attempts: Before/after each target call, inspect the exact per-process log written by frozen SpectralSurrogate.record_failure. Any appended CAMB failure stops construction and is copied/hash-bound even if Cobaya returned negative infinity. Prior/domain rejection without a recorded CAMB failure remains an ordinary rejected search point. No target or failure callback is modified.
fallback_preflight: At all three starts inspect CAMB background coordinates and polynomial positivity before any full target evaluation. Record prospective fallback causes and timing. No search point is silently replaced by a surrogate outside its native-fallback domain.
Hessian_role: Two independently evaluated central-difference Hessians and gradients of negative log posterior. Either whitened gradient exceeding0.25, nonfinite stencils, more than two eigenvalues below0.10, or step disagreement force the declared broad reference-covariance fallback; no precision claim follows. Up to two small eigenvalues may be floored to0.10 as explicit proposal-only regularization. The multiplier4 fallback is covariance, hence2 times marginal standard deviation.
mixture: Unchanged FrozenMixture:90% Gaussian with covariance1.05^2 times supplied covariance,10% Student t5 with scale matrix4*(5-2)/5 times supplied covariance (Student covariance4 times supplied covariance). Proper normalized densities, no adaptation during later sampling.
freeze_gate: At least one finite evaluated start/search point and complete declared Hessian/fallback diagnosis. Any stopped budget or failed evaluation remains visible and does not create a production-ready proposal automatically. Source/runtime/input identities and exact component/prior closure must pass.
production: Separate source-bound400-candidate pilot and four independent chains are required. Original Rminus1 twice<.005, bound<.05, rankRhat<=1.01, bulk/tailESS>=400 and all2000-point native correction/overlap gates remain unchanged. No production chain is launched by this module.
limits: Finite multistart optimization and local curvature cannot establish mode completeness. A proposal is computational only. Failed importance bridges and original duplicate-index refusal remain preserved. No calibrated likelihood or covariance is altered. Successful native fallback counts do not instrument failed internal CAMB attempts, so failures stop the construction rather than silently retry.
